-- | Haskell library for the Microsoft Language Server Protocol, data types
--   
--   An implementation of the types to allow language implementors to
--   support the Language Server Protocol for their specific language.
@package lsp-types
@version 2.3.0.1


-- | This defines the types of the LSP "metamodel", which is a
--   machine-readable format specifying the types used in the LSP protocol.
--   
--   The type system is quite typescript-y, which isn't surprising given
--   that the whole protocol is very typescript-y.
--   
--   A typescript version of the metamodel types can be found here, which
--   is useful for constructing this Haskell model of them:
--   https:/<i>github.com</i>microsoft<i>vscode-languageserver-node</i>blob<i>main</i>tools<i>src</i>metaModel.ts
module Language.LSP.MetaModel.Types

-- | What direction is this message sent in: server to client, client to
--   server, or both?
data MessageDirection
ServerToClient :: MessageDirection
ClientToServer :: MessageDirection
Both :: MessageDirection

-- | The "base types" in the metamodel.
data BaseTypeName
URI :: BaseTypeName
DocumentUri :: BaseTypeName
Integer :: BaseTypeName
UInteger :: BaseTypeName
Decimal :: BaseTypeName
RegExp :: BaseTypeName
String :: BaseTypeName
Boolean :: BaseTypeName
Null :: BaseTypeName

-- | A property of a structure.
data Property
Property :: Text -> Type -> Maybe Bool -> Maybe Text -> Maybe Text -> Maybe Bool -> Maybe Text -> Property
[name] :: Property -> Text
[type_] :: Property -> Type
[optional] :: Property -> Maybe Bool
[documentation] :: Property -> Maybe Text
[since] :: Property -> Maybe Text
[proposed] :: Property -> Maybe Bool
[deprecated] :: Property -> Maybe Text

-- | An anonymous structure type.
data StructureLiteral
StructureLiteral :: [Property] -> Maybe Text -> Maybe Text -> Maybe Bool -> Maybe Text -> StructureLiteral
[properties] :: StructureLiteral -> [Property]
[documentation] :: StructureLiteral -> Maybe Text
[since] :: StructureLiteral -> Maybe Text
[proposed] :: StructureLiteral -> Maybe Bool
[deprecated] :: StructureLiteral -> Maybe Text

-- | The various kinds of type in the metamodel.
data Type
BaseType :: BaseTypeName -> Type
[btName] :: Type -> BaseTypeName
ReferenceType :: Text -> Type
[rtName] :: Type -> Text
ArrayType :: Type -> Type
[atElement] :: Type -> Type
MapType :: Type -> Type -> Type
[mKey] :: Type -> Type
[mValue] :: Type -> Type
AndType :: NonEmpty Type -> Type
[aItems] :: Type -> NonEmpty Type
OrType :: NonEmpty Type -> Type
[oItems] :: Type -> NonEmpty Type
TupleType :: [Type] -> Type
[tItems] :: Type -> [Type]
StructureLiteralType :: StructureLiteral -> Type
[stlValue] :: Type -> StructureLiteral
StringLiteralType :: Text -> Type
[slValue] :: Type -> Text
IntegerLiteralType :: Integer -> Type
[ilValue] :: Type -> Integer
BooleanLiteralType :: Bool -> Type
[blValue] :: Type -> Bool

-- | A request message.
data Request
Request :: Text -> Maybe Type -> Type -> Maybe Type -> Maybe Type -> Maybe Type -> MessageDirection -> Maybe Text -> Maybe Text -> Maybe Bool -> Maybe Text -> Request
[method] :: Request -> Text
[params] :: Request -> Maybe Type
[result] :: Request -> Type
[partialResult] :: Request -> Maybe Type
[errorData] :: Request -> Maybe Type
[registrationOptions] :: Request -> Maybe Type
[messageDirection] :: Request -> MessageDirection
[documentation] :: Request -> Maybe Text
[since] :: Request -> Maybe Text
[proposed] :: Request -> Maybe Bool
[deprecated] :: Request -> Maybe Text

-- | A notification message.
data Notification
Notification :: Text -> Maybe Type -> Maybe Type -> MessageDirection -> Maybe Text -> Maybe Text -> Maybe Bool -> Maybe Text -> Notification
[method] :: Notification -> Text
[params] :: Notification -> Maybe Type
[registrationOptions] :: Notification -> Maybe Type
[messageDirection] :: Notification -> MessageDirection
[documentation] :: Notification -> Maybe Text
[since] :: Notification -> Maybe Text
[proposed] :: Notification -> Maybe Bool
[deprecated] :: Notification -> Maybe Text

-- | A structure type.
data Structure
Structure :: Text -> Maybe [Type] -> Maybe [Type] -> [Property] -> Maybe Text -> Maybe Text -> Maybe Bool -> Maybe Text -> Structure
[name] :: Structure -> Text
[extends] :: Structure -> Maybe [Type]
[mixins] :: Structure -> Maybe [Type]
[properties] :: Structure -> [Property]
[documentation] :: Structure -> Maybe Text
[since] :: Structure -> Maybe Text
[proposed] :: Structure -> Maybe Bool
[deprecated] :: Structure -> Maybe Text

-- | A type alias.
data TypeAlias
TypeAlias :: Text -> Type -> Maybe Text -> Maybe Text -> Maybe Bool -> Maybe Text -> TypeAlias
[name] :: TypeAlias -> Text
[type_] :: TypeAlias -> Type
[documentation] :: TypeAlias -> Maybe Text
[since] :: TypeAlias -> Maybe Text
[proposed] :: TypeAlias -> Maybe Bool
[deprecated] :: TypeAlias -> Maybe Text

-- | This is just 'string | int' on the typescript side, but it's
--   convenient to have a proper type here.
data TextOrInteger
T :: Text -> TextOrInteger
I :: Integer -> TextOrInteger

-- | An entry in an enumeration.
data EnumerationEntry
EnumerationEntry :: Text -> TextOrInteger -> Maybe Text -> Maybe Text -> Maybe Bool -> Maybe Text -> EnumerationEntry
[name] :: EnumerationEntry -> Text
[value] :: EnumerationEntry -> TextOrInteger
[documentation] :: EnumerationEntry -> Maybe Text
[since] :: EnumerationEntry -> Maybe Text
[proposed] :: EnumerationEntry -> Maybe Bool
[deprecated] :: EnumerationEntry -> Maybe Text

-- | An enumeration type.
data Enumeration
Enumeration :: Text -> Type -> [EnumerationEntry] -> Maybe Bool -> Maybe Text -> Maybe Text -> Maybe Bool -> Maybe Text -> Enumeration
[name] :: Enumeration -> Text
[type_] :: Enumeration -> Type
[values] :: Enumeration -> [EnumerationEntry]
[supportsCustomValues] :: Enumeration -> Maybe Bool
[documentation] :: Enumeration -> Maybe Text
[since] :: Enumeration -> Maybe Text
[proposed] :: Enumeration -> Maybe Bool
[deprecated] :: Enumeration -> Maybe Text

-- | Metadata about the metamodel iteslf.
data MetaData
MetaData :: Text -> MetaData
[version] :: MetaData -> Text

-- | The entire metamodel.
data MetaModel
MetaModel :: MetaData -> [Request] -> [Notification] -> [Structure] -> [Enumeration] -> [TypeAlias] -> MetaModel
[metaData] :: MetaModel -> MetaData
[requests] :: MetaModel -> [Request]
[notifications] :: MetaModel -> [Notification]
[structures] :: MetaModel -> [Structure]
[enumerations] :: MetaModel -> [Enumeration]
[typeAliases] :: MetaModel -> [TypeAlias]
